newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian holidays for 1997 - W.Australia today.
newsitem.headline: Australian holidays for 1997 - W.Australia today.

text.p: The following are scheduled Australian holidays for 1997.
Mon 09 June Queen's Birthday (public h/day except in WA)
Mon 04 Aug Bank Holiday (Bank Holiday in NSW & NT)
Wed 13 Aug RNA Show Day (public h/day Brisbane Metro)
Mon 29 Sep Queen's Birthday (public h/day in WA)
Mon 06 Oct Labour Day (public h/day ACT, NSW, SA)
Tue 04 Nov Melbourne Cup (public h/day VIC)
Thu 25 Dec Christmas Day (public h/day all states)
Fri 26 Dec Boxing Day (public h/day all states)
